description: Forward-prevention baseline for the 10 architectural diagnosis rules (PR-DIAGNOSI-FINALE, July 2026). Documents (a) the canonical-owner allowlists each archcheck scanner enforces and (b) the legitimately-retained residue caller-sties (test fixtures + godlike/07 migration-window permits). Forward-prevention discipline: any NEW caller trips the corresponding gate as a CI build failure unless the scanner's hardcoded allowlist AND this baseline JSON are updated in the same PR. Per godlike/07 NO-FAKE-AVAILABILITY, the baseline is the snapshot of LEGITIMATE callers that MUST remain — silent regressions (a future contributor introducing a new caller) get caught by the forward-prevention gate, not by manual review.

residue_allowed.reason: Forward-pointer to step 2 of PR-MEDIATRANSFORMER-RENAME. The existing fields (DriveLink, DriveFileID, DownloadLink, FolderID, MD5, PublishAction, ClipPageURL in TransformSpec / RenditionSet) STAY in the DTOs until step 2 deletes them. The gate trips on these existing fields by design — the violations are EXPECTED and documented as forward-pointers.

percheck_input_immutability.canonical_owner: Each use case or handler treats caller-owned pointer input contracts as read-only and derives local normalized values or dedicated outputs
percheck_input_immutability.detection: Go AST object identity; line-oriented name regexes are forbidden because local DTOs and value copies are not caller-visible mutations
forbidden_operations: whole tracked pointer target reassignment through *input = ...
direct or nested field assignment through a tracked pointer input
indexed assignment through a tracked pointer input
increment or decrement through a tracked pointer input
mutation from a nested closure capturing a tracked pointer input
excluded_by_design: value parameters normalized inside a function
